player_prompt.intro:
Wi ule Muthu {player_id} ({role}) mu nthandau ya Matching Pennies ya {num_rounds} nthanda.
- Nthanda ili yonse, tuma [heads] kapena [tails] (kapena [h], [t]).
- Ukapata chaguo chako chikukwana na cha mpinzani wako, Muthu 0 akupata nthanda; wakati wasi Muthu 1 akupata.
Dzuka na chaguo chako mu mfumo wa '[heads]' kapena '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Muthu 0 apata {choice0}; Muthu 1 apata {choice1}. Kukwana -> Muthu 0 akupata
message.round_mismatch: Muthu 0 apata {choice0}; Muthu 1 apata {choice1}. Kuto kwana -> Muthu 1 akupata.
